in_scope.instructions:
The Simple Goals app can be installed from the [Slack App directory](slack.com/apps/AU9M045ML-simple-goals) and then subsequently be used from within the Slack client.

Of course the slack app directory website, or the Slack client itself are not within scope of this program. However, Slack does offer their own bug bounty: https://slack.com/intl/en-gb/report-vulnerability

As with all other assets in scope, automated testing is not permitted
